description: Testbench inventory for sky130-adpll: the five RTL cocotb suites (loop filter, divider, lock detect, DCO code, top) and the sim/pdk-smoke inverter bench (toolchain proof, not a design result). The cold start re-runs the cocotb suites and checks their run records. DCO (spec rows 2, 3) and TDC (rows 6a, 6b) benches are not inventoried: they are added by #51 and #52 and this attestation is regenerated then. Pre-layout, simulated; nothing here is a measurement.

argv: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -r verification/requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python verification/run_tests.py && .venv/bin/python verification/check_records.py
